label.takesSeconds: This takes a few seconds. Everything happens on your phone.

label.failNothing: I could not find any nutrition values in that photo. Try again with the table filling the frame, in good light, and held flat.
settings.title: Settings
settings.profileIntro: Answer a few short questions and get a suggested calorie and macro goal.
settings.backupTextUnprotected: Your data lives only on this phone, and iOS may clear it if the app is not used for a long time. Back up regularly, and keep the file in iCloud Drive.
settings.backupText: Your data lives only on this phone. Back up now and then, and keep the file in iCloud Drive.
settings.backupFailed: The backup could not be saved.
settings.importFailed: The import failed. Nothing was changed.
settings.recentsHint: Empties the Recent list on the Add screen. Your favourites, saved foods and history stay.
import.summary: This backup{from} holds {entries} entries, {foods} foods, {preps} meal preps, {meals} saved meals and {weights} weigh-ins.
import.mergeHint: Adds what is missing and skips duplicates. Nothing on this phone is changed.
import.replaceHint: Deletes all data on this phone and puts the backup in its place.

prep.title: Meal prep
prep.emptyIngredients: Add everything that goes into the pot, with its raw weight.
prep.weighHint: Weigh the whole finished dish (without the pot).
prep.rawHint: The raw ingredients weigh {grams} g together.
prep.problem.name: Give the meal prep a name.
prep.problem.weight: Enter the weight of the finished dish.
prep.problem.portions: The number of portions has to be more than 0.
prep.intro: Cook once, log all week. Add the ingredients of a dish, weigh the finished pot, and the app works out the nutrition per 100 g and per portion.
onb.goalText: This sets how many calories and how much protein to aim for.
goal.lose.desc: Eat a bit less than you burn
goal.muscle.desc: Eat a bit more, with plenty of protein
goal.recomp.desc: Body recomposition: lose fat while building muscle
goal.maintain.desc: Keep your weight where it is
activity.sedentary.desc: Desk job or studying, little exercise
activity.extreme.desc: Physical job or training twice a day
onb.targetTitle: What weight are you aiming for?
onb.targetOptional: You weigh {kg} kg now. A target is optional here: leave it empty if the scale is not your goal.
onb.sexText: The formula for calories uses a different number for men and women.
onb.activityText: Think of a normal week, including work or study.
onb.paceMuscle: A slower pace adds less fat along with the muscle.
onb.paceDeficit: A faster pace means eating less each day. Slower is easier to keep up.
onb.paceNone: None of these fit you right now, so your calories will stay at the lowest safe level instead.
onb.tapNumber: Tap a number to change it.
onb.underweight: A target of {target} kg is below the healthy range for your height. Consider a higher target, and talk to a doctor first.
theme.title: Choose your theme
goal.missing: One thing is missing from your profile.
goal.recompOptional: A target weight is optional for body recomposition.
pace.line: {pace} kg per week · {kcal} kcal per day
calc.maintainText: That is your target, to keep your weight where it is.
calc.loseText: Losing {pace} kg a week takes about {kcal} kcal less per day.
calc.muscleText: Gaining {pace} kg a week takes about {kcal} kcal more per day.
calc.recompText: Body recomposition at {pace} kg a week takes about {kcal} kcal less per day.
calc.under18: Under 18, eating less than you burn is not advised without a doctor, so this is your maintenance level.
calc.floor: Losing {pace} kg a week would put you below the {bmr} kcal your body uses at rest, so I stopped there. Expect about {slower} kg a week instead.
calc.explanation: Your body uses about {bmr} kcal at rest (Mifflin-St Jeor). Times {factor} for your activity gives {maintenance} kcal to maintain. {goal} Protein is about {perKg} g per kg of body weight, fat {fat}% of calories, and carbs the rest.
calc.notUnder18: Not available under 18 without a doctor.
calc.notAvailable: Not available: it would mean eating less than the {bmr} kcal your body uses at rest.
calc.recompTip: That is more than 5 kg below your current weight. The goal “Lose weight” may suit you better.
calc.targetRange: Enter a weight between 30 and 300 kg.
calc.targetLower: To lose weight, your target has to be below your current {kg} kg.
calc.targetHigher: To build muscle, your target has to be above your current {kg} kg.
calc.longRoad: That is about {months} months away at this pace. A long road, but a fine goal: you can change it any time.
disclaimer: These numbers are estimates, not medical advice. Do your own research, and talk to a doctor or dietitian for advice that fits you.
backup.err.json: That file is not a backup: it is not valid JSON.
backup.err.notOurs: That file is not a backup from this app.
backup.err.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
backup.err.noData: This backup is damaged: it has no products or entries.
